entities.name: Worzel
entities.description: A planeswalker who prepares to duel her rival Thomil, having lost to his red magic and later learned white magic.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: Worzel's rival, who defeated her with red magic and now uses nearly learned black magic.

events.summary: Thomil challenges Worzel to another battle.
events.quote: After Thomil challenged her to another battle, Worzel summoned green creatures

events.summary: Thomil surprises Worzel by using black magic; Worzel readies white magic and the fight begins.
events.quote: She readied her own newly learned white magic, and the fight begins.

relations.note: Rival whom she lost to previously and duels again.
relations.quote: about the planeswalker Worzel preparing to duel her rival Thomil .
